evidence.reason: The test method is named as proving bounded dispatch without inbox enumeration, but it only asserts that process_item is called once with [job]. It does not mock or assert that the inbox-listing path is untouched, so an implementation that lists the whole inbox before dispatching [job] would still satisfy the existing assertions. This is a routine test-correctness gap in the stated behavior, not a new requirement; add a guard around the inbox-listing call while retaining the dispatch and JSON artifact assertions.
